parsed.rationale: Function schemas for the 13 tools and error-return behaviour (error observations that still cost a step, malformed submission scores 0) are documented. Per-tool side effects (read versus write) are not documented on S1-S3, and the visible S5 tool descriptions do not state them for all tools, so S5 reach cannot be told.
